title: orders-api error-rate SLO burn
description: Elevated latency on orders-api (p95 947ms) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: Cross-zone network degradation between orders-api and inventory-service pushed call latency beyond the 800ms timeout; inventory-service itself was healthy.
expected_symptoms: orders-api downstream_latency_ms rises from ~115ms to ~937ms (client timeout 800ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from orders-api to inventory-service
orders-api p95 latency rises to ~947ms, error rate up to ~17.9%
orders-api CPU and memory stay near baseline
inventory-service server-side latency normal while caller-observed latency is high
resolution: Routed traffic to same-zone endpoints until the cloud provider fixed the network issue.
